evidence: Directly refactors core argument parsing and flag checking in src/common/args.cpp and src/common/args.h.
rationale: Enforces proper argument fetching patterns across the codebase to prevent error-prone usage of GetArg() on list options and fixes inconsistent parsing for empty options like -blockfilterindex="". It also establishes infrastructure that unblocks follow-up config validation work such as #17493.
